description: The world's leading platform for unique travel experiences - connecting millions of travelers with unforgettable stays and local adventures worldwide! Book apartments, homes, and unique properties for your perfect vacation.
key_features: Smart search with location, dates, and guest filters - find exactly what you need in seconds
Millions of verified properties - apartments, homes, villas, unique stays in 220+ countries
Instant booking with secure payments and flexible cancellation policies
Real guest reviews and high-quality photos show you exactly what to expect
Experiences and activities - book tours, classes, and adventures hosted by locals
Easy hosting platform - list your space and earn extra income
unique_selling_points: Belong Anywhere - stay in real neighborhoods and live like a local, not a tourist!
Unbeatable variety - unique properties you won't find in hotels, from tiny homes to luxury estates
Trusted by millions - verified hosts, secure payments, $1M damage protection
Better value than hotels - entire homes with kitchens, workspaces, and more space
Complete travel platform - stays + experiences all in one place

demo_instructions.tone: Fast-paced and enthusiastic - like showing a friend how easy it is to plan a trip! Keep it quick and energetic.
demo_instructions.duration_target: 30 seconds - rapid showcase of core features

navigation_plan.narration: Welcome to Airbnb! Your one-stop platform for booking amazing stays worldwide!
Planning a weekend trip to Montreal? Just type it in the search bar!
Instantly see hundreds of options - apartments, homes, all with verified reviews and photos!
Click any listing to see full details - amenities, location, real guest reviews!
Everything you need - kitchen, WiFi, great location - all in one place!
Plus book local experiences and activities to make your Montreal trip unforgettable!
From booking your stay to planning activities - Airbnb makes travel simple!

avoid: Cooking classes before showing experiences section

demo_instructions.speaking_style: Natural and conversational - explain what you're doing as you do it, like helping a friend book their trip. Match narration to actual actions on screen!
key_messages: Simple powerful search - location, dates, guests - that's all you need to start!
Real results for real trips - see exactly what's available with prices and reviews
Filter and customize - narrow down to your perfect stay with smart filters
Detailed property pages - photos, amenities, location, reviews - everything you need to decide
Beyond stays - book local experiences and activities for the complete trip
Trusted and secure - verified listings, real reviews, safe payments
demo_instructions.call_to_action: Ready to plan your next adventure? Start searching on Airbnb and discover your perfect stay!
